title: Hot Smoked Vietnamese Tofu Curry
description: A smoky and chewy Vietnamese dish featuring glace cherry and served in individual mini cocottes, perfect for a brunch mood, this satvik friendly curry is a delicious twist on traditional Vietnamese cuisine.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the smoked paprika, curry powder, salt, and black pepper.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and add the sliced onion, cooking until softened.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cubed tofu to the skillet and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the glace cherry, coconut milk, and spice mixture to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Divide the curry mixture among individual mini cocottes and bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes.
Remove the cocottes from the oven and serve hot.
